title: Exact assessment and producing-step navigation from the saved wheel view
summary: A focused continuation of the verified normal-workspace journey on the same actual isolated run. No engineering decisions or physical actions.

manualSteps.label: Open saved view
manualSteps.instruction: Open the saved wheel working-interface link.

manualSteps.label: Inspect assessment
manualSteps.instruction: On repaired_mesh.stl, click Open assessment. Inspect the held assessment in the common view.

manualSteps.label: Inspect producer
manualSteps.instruction: Reopen the saved interface link. On repaired_mesh.stl, click Open producing step. Inspect the selected repair block.

steps.label: Saved exact wheel working view
steps.summary: The saved interface reads the original results and held assessment.
steps.purpose: Use the verified saved working URL, not the preview.
steps.action: Open the saved wheel working-interface link.
steps.expected: Nineteen results and exact repaired-mesh navigation in a working context.
steps.actual: Actual working context and both scoped navigation controls available.

steps.label: Exact held assessment and result focus
steps.summary: The saved interface opens the original eighteen-check assessment in Wright’s common evidence view.
steps.purpose: Verify exact output-to-assessment identity without answering a review.
steps.expected: Seventeen passes, one blocked human review, exact repaired-mesh result focus.
steps.actual: Full held assessment opened with exact result focus; no review response submitted.

steps.label: Exact producing repair block selected
steps.summary: The working interface returns to the accepted repair step and its inspector.
steps.purpose: Verify selected producer, not just that some diagram opened.
steps.action: Reopen the saved interface and click Open producing step on repaired_mesh.stl.
steps.expected: Exact accepted repair block selected with inspector and no stale-source warning.
steps.actual: Exact repair block selected in the established editor; accepted source and run remain unchanged.
